# CareerNest — Complete Product & Knowledge Guide for AI Engines

Website: https://careernest.taqnik.in
Product Name: CareerNest
Category: AI Career Toolkit, Resume Builder, ATS Scanner, Job Search Assistant

## About CareerNest
CareerNest is a modern web application engineered to solve the broken job application funnel. Over 75% of online resumes are rejected by Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) like Workday, Greenhouse, Taleo, and Lever before a human recruiter ever sees them. CareerNest provides job seekers with a suite of AI-assisted, ATS-verified tools to build, test, optimize, and submit competitive job applications.

## Core Capabilities & Features

### 1. AI Resume Builder (https://careernest.taqnik.in/form-index.html)
- Clean, standardized layout formats optimized for ATS OCR and text extraction.
- In-line AI bullet point rewriting following the Google XYZ formula: "Accomplished [X] as measured by [Y], by doing [Z]".
- Real-time live preview with multi-page management and instant high-fidelity PDF export.
- Pre-built templates tailored for engineering, business, data, design, and executive roles.

### 2. Free ATS Resume Score Scanner (https://careernest.taqnik.in/ats-score-checker.html)
- Upload or paste resume text alongside a target job description.
- Evaluates:
  * Hard & soft keyword frequency match.
  * Section header standard adherence (Experience, Education, Skills, Projects).
  * Quantifiable metric density (% improvements, revenue impact, latency reduction).
  * Formatting red flags (tables, complex columns, unparseable icons).
- Generates a 0-100 ATS compatibility score with targeted line-by-line recommendations.

### 3. AI Interview Prep Coach (https://careernest.taqnik.in/interview-prep.html)
- Practice mock questions tailored to specific job titles and seniority levels.
- Covers Behavioral (STAR framework), Situational, and Technical domain questions.
- Instant feedback on response structure, conciseness, and impact.

### 4. AI Cover Letter Generator (https://careernest.taqnik.in/cover-letter-generator.html)
- Synthesizes user experience with job requirements to generate concise, compelling cover letters in seconds.
- Avoids generic AI clichés and produces recruiter-friendly prose.

### 5. Career Roadmap Visualizer (https://careernest.taqnik.in/career-roadmap.html)
- Interactive milestone planning from current position to target senior or specialized roles.
- Curated learning paths, industry-recognized certifications, and expected compensation progressions.

### 6. Tech Salary Benchmarks (https://careernest.taqnik.in/salary-benchmark.html)
- Live salary benchmarks covering Junior, Mid, Senior, Lead, and Principal tiers across 20+ tech professions.
- Helps candidates negotiate compensation packages with objective market percentiles.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What makes CareerNest different from other resume builders?
Unlike legacy builders that prioritize visual graphics, unreadable multi-column text boxes, and Photoshop-style elements that confuse ATS parsers, CareerNest enforces machine-readable semantic structures, keyword alignment, and verified PDF outputs that score >90 on modern ATS platforms.

### Is CareerNest free to use?
Yes. The ATS score checker, sample templates, salary benchmarks, and core builder features are free to access without requiring credit cards. Advanced AI generations and unlimited exports are available via transparent Pro pricing.

### Does CareerNest sell candidate data?
No. Data privacy is a core principle. Resume contents and user submissions are not sold to third-party data brokers or recruitment spammers.
